ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the distance from the midpoint \(M\) of one side of the rhombus \(ABCD\) to the intersection point \(O\) of the diagonals is \(1.5\, \text{cm}\). What is the perimeter of the rhombus \(ABCD\) in centimeters?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Let point $M$ be the midpoint of side $AB$ of rhombus $ABCD$, and let point $O$ be the midpoint of diagonal $BD$, with $OM=1.5\,cm$, \\
$\therefore$ in $\triangle ABD$, we have $OM=\frac{1}{2}AD=1.5$, \\
$\therefore$ $AB=BC=CD=DA=2OM=3$, \\
thus, the perimeter of the rhombus $ABCD$ is $\boxed{12}$.
